dataset.attribution: Liu, Liangyun and Zhang, Xiao (2025), GLC_FCS10, doi:10.5281/zenodo.14729665. Zhang et al. (2025), Earth System Science Data 17, 4039–4062, doi:10.5194/essd-17-4039-2025. Retain the author licence, record version and publisher legend for class interpretation.
dataset.valueInterpretation: Original single-band UInt8 categorical codes, scale 1 and offset 0. The actual TIFFs declare no NoData; zero and every stored code remain raw values and are not converted into a missing-data mask. Consult the publisher classification legend for class meanings. The 2023 reference year and 2025 publication are not individual image acquisition dates; no physical reflectance or spectral bands are inferred.

warnings: Only six completely checked W175N55/N60/N65/N70/S10/S15 original TIFFs are eligible. A grayscale preview displays original class indices, not continuous quantities. The actual TIFFs declare no NoData, and no class-code-to-quality mask or regional accuracy is invented.

dataset.title: GLC_FCS30D · 1985 land-cover classes
dataset.description: The author's original GLC_FCS30D historical classification product. Reviewed scope is eight whole three-band TIFF members in one complete W175-W180 ZIP. dataset.valueInterpretation: Original three-band UInt8 categorical arrays, scale 1 and offset 0. Publisher guide defines band order as 1985, 1990 and 1995, despite the old filename containing 19852000 and TIFF photometric tag RGB. These channels are classification years, not red/green/blue sensor bands. The guide identifies 0 and 250 as filled codes, while the actual TIFFs declare no scalar NoData; raw values and null embedded NoData are retained separately, without a synthetic mask. The first-band grayscale preview is 1985 only; the other years are not silently selected for display.
